_comment: Annotation messages as GitHub Actions writes them on a job: the first list on a job whose runner was lost, the second on jobs that failed, timed out, or were cancelled for other reasons.
runner_lost: The runner has received a shutdown signal. This can happen when the runner service is stopped, or a manually started runner is canceled.

The self-hosted runner: ubuntu-24.04-riscv-7 lost communication with the server. Verify the machine is running and has a healthy network connection. Anything in your workflow that terminates the runner process, starves it for CPU/Memory, or blocks its network access can cause this error.

The hosted runner: GitHub Actions 12 lost communication with the server. Anything in your workflow that terminates the runner process, starves it for CPU/Memory, or blocks its network access can cause this error.
not_runner_lost: The job running on runner ubuntu-24.04-riscv-7 has exceeded the maximum execution time of 360 minutes.
Error: The runner has received a shutdown signal. This can happen when the runner service is stopped.
